title: Stripe Payments vs PayPal Checkout
summary: A developer-first payment platform versus a wallet-led checkout with broad buyer familiarity; in both cases your business generally remains the seller.
recommendation: Choose Stripe as the primary stack when APIs, payment-method breadth, and modular billing matter. Add or choose PayPal when buyer wallet preference and PayPal conversion are central. Many businesses support both rather than treating the decision as exclusive.

differences.first: Composable payments infrastructure and developer tooling.
differences.second: A familiar buyer wallet and PayPal-branded checkout.
differences.whyItMatters: The right primary option depends on your buyers and required integration depth.

differences.second: PayPal Checkout is listed at 3.49% + $0.49, with separate card rates.
differences.whyItMatters: Compare the exact payment method, not the company-level headline.

differences.first: Checkout, Elements, Payment Links, mobile SDKs, and APIs.
differences.second: PayPal Checkout and Expanded Checkout with different customization and risk options.
differences.whyItMatters: Implementation effort and merchant control differ.

differences.first: Stripe Billing is a separate priced product with extensive lifecycle APIs.
differences.second: PayPal provides subscriptions and recurring-payment APIs.
differences.whyItMatters: Model lifecycle requirements before selecting a subscription stack.

differences.first: Your business owns tax, disputes, and product support.
differences.second: Your business remains seller; eligible PayPal protections have conditions.
differences.whyItMatters: Neither standard product is a general Merchant of Record.

scenarios.when: You are building an API-driven SaaS billing stack.
scenarios.reason: Its modular payments and Billing APIs are the stronger center of gravity.

scenarios.when: Your audience explicitly asks for PayPal or prefers wallet balances.
scenarios.reason: Buyer familiarity can matter more than a small fee difference.

scenarios.when: You serve a mixed consumer audience.
scenarios.reason: Use Stripe as the primary card stack and evaluate PayPal as an additional method rather than forcing a false either-or choice.
